Who gets the alarm

Every Pocket user has one, shown in their Profile. They must have Pocket installed and signed in — the alarm arrives inside the app.

Admin is copied even when you name someone else. One person can miss a phone; two rarely do.

Check-in
Ask me to check inA loud alarm you have to answer

Then the SOS goes out by itself. This pause is why a missed alarm while you are up a ladder does not scramble anyone.

Using Pocket counts as a check-inTake a photo, rate a defect — the clock resets. Fewer alarms, same cover.

At that time Pocket asks once. No answer still raises the alarm — not answering at the end of a job is exactly when something has gone wrong.

Pocket needs your location, and must stay open on screen for the alarm to sound.
